name: Lamar Wise

bio.statement: A Multnomah County release says Wise was appointed to House District 48 on November 5, 2025, and is political director for AFSCME Council 75.
bio.excerpt: political director for Oregon Council 75 of the American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees

bio.statement: The Oregon Capital Chronicle described Wise at his appointment as former political director of the state AFSCME union and former executive director of the Oregon Student Association.
bio.excerpt: former executive director of the Oregon Student Association

bio.statement: OPB, republishing the Capital Chronicle, reports the state ethics commission voted 8-0 to open a full investigation of Wise over an alleged unreported $25,000 stipend.
bio.excerpt: voted 8-0 to open a full investigation into Rep. Lamar Wise, D-Portland

bio.statement: In the same report, Wise says he amended his financial form, called the omission an honest mistake, and expects it to be resolved soon.
bio.excerpt: this honest mistake, and expect it to be resolved soon.

positions.statement: At his appointment, Wise said he would focus on improving housing and uplifting Oregon's economy, per the Capital Chronicle.
positions.excerpt: improving housing and uplifting Oregon’s economy.

positions.statement: The Capital Chronicle also reported Wise intends to carry on advocacy for education and reducing chronic absenteeism.
positions.excerpt: advocating for education and reducing Oregon’s chronic absenteeism.

voting_record.statement: The Portland Tribune reports Wise proposed legislation on chronic absenteeism data; he said the Department of Education should use data it already has.
voting_record.excerpt: We're really asking for the Department of Education to use the data that they already have,
